v2_physics_and_contract_corrections.item_4_gain_bias_calculation: Corrected relative gain bias formula to exp(Ts/tau_d) - 1; noted Ts/tau_d = 1e-4 gives ~0.01% (not 0.02%); for the declared pedagogical model (Ts=10 ns, tau_d=50 us, Ts/tau_d=2e-4), evaluated exact bias ~0.0200%; explicitly labelled as a declared pedagogical choice rather than universal hardware.
v2_physics_and_contract_corrections.item_5_baseline_variance_and_covariance: Clarified that sigma_BL^2 = sigma_v^2 / N strictly assumes i.i.d. white noise; noted that low-frequency drift and filtering introduce sample autocorrelation; explicitly stated the net energy variance relation Var(s - BL) = Var(s) + Var(BL) - 2 Cov(s, BL), requiring statistical independence and common gain/energy unit mapping for simple quadratic addition.
v2_physics_and_contract_corrections.item_6_pileup_probability_linearity: Removed unconditioned claim of strictly linear pile-up probability; clarified that for Poisson arrivals with rate R, probability of >= 1 arrival in window T is 1 - exp(-RT), which approximates RT only in the low-rate limit RT << 1.
v2_physics_and_contract_corrections.item_7_pur_window_and_pzc_baseline_quali: Qualified that PUR inspection window (k + ell)Ts is a declared pedagogical implementation rather than universal firmware logic; explicitly stated that PZC mismatch creating undershoot/overshoot and rate-dependent peak shifts is analyzed within the declared LTI recursive model and simple baseline subtraction, as advanced adaptive baseline algorithms may behave differently.
v2_physics_and_contract_corrections.item_8_tone_and_asymptotic_deficit_wordi: Replaced universal assertion that asymptotic zero deficit is theoretically impossible with the factual statement that the declared double-exponential model retains deterministic residual deficit under the given sampling/extraction rules; pruned self-praising and prescriptive phrasing; converted conclusion into a natural connected paragraph.
